title: 第8章 威慑力
slug: 什么叫我鲸吞了lpl的气运
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

比赛时间二十三分钟，VG在场上展现出了一种肉眼可见的散乱。

整个团队逐渐陷入了一种“不知道该去哪、该干什么”的真空状态。

他们边线不敢带得太深，野区不敢盲目涉足，连辅助在排眼做视野时都显得战战兢兢、犹豫不决。

因为在地图的任何一个角落，随时都可能亮起卡牌大师大招。

这正是卡牌单带体系最恶心的地方，只要他手里握着命运，威慑力就无处不在。

到了二十四分钟，VG终于按捺不住了。

他们心里很清楚，如果再这样拖下去，等LGD下路大嘴的三件套一成型，后期的团战将变得彻底无法处理。

他们必须主动撕开大龙坑的视野，强行逼一波团。

屏幕上，VG的野区豹女开始绕后，辅助牛头开启扫描摸进河道，Easyhoon的瑞兹则在中路疯狂推线施压。

“VG这波想接团！他们坐不住了！”解说席上，米勒的语速骤然加快，“这个时间节点，他们必须主动站出来打！”

面对VG来势汹汹的逼团之势，LGD的麦克风里，陈周却只是淡定说道：“别急，Imp让Marin继续带，我们等牛头。”

简简单单的一句话，让LGD的战略部署立马清晰起来。

在这场比赛过去的二十多分钟里，无论是世界冠军MaRin、imp，还是原本容易上头打乱节奏的Eimy，都已经本能地习惯了去听这个新人的声音。

二十五分钟，当VG的牛头刚刚踏进河道草丛探路的刹那，陈周果断按下了R键。

命运，骤然开启！

VG全员的站位在大屏幕上暴露无遗。

更致命的是，原本潜伏在侧翼、企图寻找机会切入的豹女，身边竟然没有一个队友保护。

“开豹女。”陈周的声音依旧平静得不起波澜。

下一秒，黄牌破空而出，猪妹跟上，布隆更是直接闪现接上控制，大嘴的伤害跟上。

VG的野区核心连切换豹形态位移一小段距离的机会都没有，就被融化在了密集的技能伤害中。

“秒了！直接秒了！！”娃娃的嗓子喊到破音，“LGD在没有任何拉扯的情况下，瞬间集火秒掉了VG的打野！那这条大龙没有争夺的悬念了啊！！”

第(1/3)页
content_en:
Page (1/3)

Twenty-three minutes into the game, VG showed a visible disarray on the court.

The entire team gradually fell into a vacuum of "not knowing where to go or what to do."

They didn't dare to go too deep on the sidelines, and they didn't dare to blindly enter the jungle. Even the support seemed trepidatious and hesitant when lining up for vision.

Because in any corner of the map, the card master's ultimate move may appear at any time.

This is the most disgusting part of the single-band card system. As long as he holds destiny in his hands, the deterrent power is everywhere.

At twenty-four minutes, VG finally couldn't hold it any longer.

They know very well that if this continues, once LGD's three-piece set with a big mouth in the bottom lane is formed, the team battles in the later stages will become completely unmanageable.

They must take the initiative to open up the view of Dalong Pit and force a wave of attacks.

On the screen, VG's jungle leopard girl began to circle back, assisting the bull head to start scanning and touch into the river, while Easyhoon's Ryze was crazily pushing the lane in the middle to put pressure.

"VG wants to take over the team now! They can't sit still!" Miller's speaking speed suddenly accelerated in the commentary box, "At this point in time, they must take the initiative to stand up and fight!"

Faced with VG's menacing pressure to force the team, Chen Zhou just said calmly on LGD's microphone: "Don't worry, Imp asked Marin to continue to lead, we will wait for the bull head."

A simple sentence made LGD's strategic plan immediately clear.

In the past twenty minutes of this game, both world champions MaRin and imp, as well as Eimy, who was prone to disrupting the rhythm, have instinctively become accustomed to listening to this newcomer's voice.

Twenty-five minutes later, when VG's bullhead had just stepped into the river grass to explore its path, Chen Zhou decisively pressed the R key.

Destiny suddenly opens!

The positions of all VG members were clearly exposed on the big screen.

What's even more fatal is that the Leopard Girl, who was originally lurking on the flank, trying to find an opportunity to cut in, didn't have a teammate to protect her.

"Open the Leopard Girl." Chen Zhou's voice was still calm and unruffled.

The next second, the yellow card came out of the air, Pig Girl followed up, and Bron flashed directly to take control, and Big Mouth's damage kept up.

VG's jungle core didn't even have a chance to switch to leopard form and move a short distance before being melted into the intensive skill damage.

"It's a second! It's a second!!" Watana's voice shouted to the breaking point, "LGD concentrated fire and killed VG's jungler in an instant without any effort! Then there is no suspense for this big dragon!!"
